newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oil weakens, low sulphur fla.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oil weakens, low sulphur fla.

text.p: NWE high sulphur fuel oil cargoes were weaker on Thursday amid little utility interest and good supply.
Offers fell to around $84 and $85 cif NWE but no trades were seen done with bids stuck at $82 or lower.
High sulphur fuel oil barges slipped from yesterday's $90 to see business done at $87 fob ARA before sinking slightly further in slim trade. There was little bunker interest.

Low sulphur fuel oil offers were scarce in the prompt period and prices stayed notionally static at around swaps levels or slightly higher. March swaps were talked around $96 fob NWE. - Sean Maguire, London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
